posts.title: death can't breathe on tuesdays
posts.description: In the otiose evening of August — it is always August — you are dead. Death is so loud , I say, or think I say, between the clamorous pangs drowning a whole world out. I do my best to sit with your death, a wish whispered to the heavens, returned as something so deafening, as something so boisterously full, it fills my body until I’m dead too.
